# Skill-Assisted Job Match Workflow

1. Resolve the target from a current complete JD, exact role dossier, old partial exact-role evidence, or company role-family evidence in that order.
2. Preserve Responsibilities, Required, and Preferred exactly as their source classifies them. Repetition may trigger review but never changes necessity.
3. Keep inferred signals separate with basis, source, and confidence; never convert them into source text or company hard gates.
4. Retrieve only relevant owning evidence from `personal-data/`; apply F1–F6 and P0–P3 gates before composing claims.
5. Map evidence using only the five canonical Chinese states. Assess Critical/Major/Minor gap impact independently.
6. Evaluate location and other application constraints separately as `satisfied`, `unsatisfied`, `unknown`, or `not_applicable`; never average hard constraints with skills.
7. Produce a multidimensional recommendation. Tier B has unknown explicit coverage. Any requested score must disclose weights, denominator, unknowns, and `heuristic=true`.
8. Export only confirmed, worthwhile gaps to a roadmap when explicitly requested. Plans do not update evidence; a verified artifact must first enter its personal-data owner, then `refresh-match` may reassess.
9. Refresh only requirements whose owning source hash changed, preserve conflicts, and leave unchanged evidence mappings untouched.
